typed_remainders.statement: Two seals in this receipt were platform dependent by construction and are now corrected pre-execution. (1) The outcome module digest sealed a module that derived ADMISSIBLE_RHO_LOW from libm at import: Linux/CPython 3.11 gives 0x1.032ba5565697cp-3 where Windows/CPython 3.13 gives 0x1.032ba5565697dp-3, one ulp apart, and the latter is the value this manifest froze as rho_low_binary64_hex before either platform ran. The endpoints are now pinned by bit pattern, so the preregistered value governs and the derivation no longer can; the outcome module digest is resealed from sha256:e0f1441a... to sha256:24fbd509..., and effective_protocol_digest moves with it. (2) source_matrix_payload hashes to_sl2(swirl_point(...)) output, is therefore a digest of cosh and sinh's last bit, and does not agree across the two platforms; it is demoted from a hard gate to a reported comparison. The matrices are a deterministic function of the two coordinate payloads under a map this repository already pins, so the demotion removes no binding. The coordinate payloads remain hard gates and agree bit for bit on both platforms. This is the third instance of one defect in this repository -- R6k input_hashes over computed float arrays, .jsonl under text=auto, and now a transcendental's last bit inside a seal. A check that cannot pass on a second operating system is not evidence of reproduction; it is evidence of a single machine.
typed_remainders.residual: No cross-platform claim is made for source_matrix_payload. Bit-level agreement of the SL(2,C) matrices is untested and remains open; only the semantic invariant det == 1 to 1e-12 is asserted.

typed_remainders.statement: PRE-EXECUTION REPAIR, 2026-09-25, no Part B result exists. The C_pre rule anchors the tag to the earliest commit carrying the live input-freeze bytes and requires that commit to hold the current bytes of all five C_pre paths. On the history before this entry NO commit satisfied both: 756728e is the only carrier of the prior manifest bytes, and tests/test_part_b_preflight.py was changed after it, at a6d8b99 -- the commit that recorded the tag-publication blocker, whose own binding_remainder named exactly this hole. So the gate could never pass, with or without tag-push access, and the test's skip on tag absence concealed that behind the environment blocker. This entry changes no scientific input, threshold, projection, correction or surface; it exists so that the commit adding it is the earliest carrier of the live bytes AND holds all five current C_pre files, which makes it the one valid C_pre.
